grammar.title: Natural Humor in Japanese
bullets: Use 〜ました for polite past tense.
The term '天然' (tennen) is used to describe someone with a natural, airheaded charm, often endearing in Japanese entertainment.
In Tokyo, being '天然' is seen as a charming trait, especially in the entertainment industry.
